content: {"like": ["The neomorphs were an interesting creation."],"dislike": ["Ridley Scott caved in to studio or fan pressure, compromising his vision.","The inclusion of the classic xenomorph was seen as a waste of the original ideas.","The characters (except Walter and David) were cardboard cutouts with no emotional connection.","The plot twist was predictable and unnecessary.","The film glossed over the origin story, making it hard to remember.","The potential of the new creatures introduced in Prometheus was largely dumped."]}
